remediation.title: Envelope accepts noncontributory X25519 recipients
remediation.summary: Validate every recipient with contributory X25519 agreement before creating the content key; retain the pinned encapsulation implementation.
remediation.requiredVerification: Actual compiled WASM refusal of low-order and equivalent encodings plus ordinary recipient/SSKR controls; library proof that all-zero agreement cannot yield a wrapping key. Canonical source/output verification at release.
remediation.verificationScope: Passed named targeted regressions and stated source/build checks; browser and release acceptance remain unexecuted.

remediation.title: Core CSV exports label a pending transaction as confirmed
remediation.summary: Use one Core confirmation-state owner across display and all exports, preserving pending independently of lock flags.
remediation.requiredVerification: Inspect actual single/batch CSV for pending, confirmed and locked combinations with null/zero distinction.
remediation.verificationScope: Passed named targeted regressions and stated source/build checks; browser and release acceptance remain unexecuted.

remediation.title: Dash Shielded derivation wipes the caller seed and changes output on reuse
remediation.summary: Give the mutable Dash WASM binding a disposable seed copy and wipe it in finally; preserve caller ownership on success and failure.
remediation.requiredVerification: Actual WASM success/failure paths preserve caller bytes; repeated calls and mixed protocol derivations remain deterministic; fresh-copy control and independent pinned Orchard output remain valid.
remediation.verificationScope: Passed named targeted regressions and stated source/build checks; browser and release acceptance remain unexecuted.

remediation.title: Envelope restoration discards malformed or ambiguous passphrase assertions
remediation.summary: Propagate malformed and duplicate typed passphrase assertions; transfer decoded entropy without a redundant copy and wipe on all validation paths.
remediation.requiredVerification: Actual WASM absent/empty/nonempty/wrong-type/duplicate bundle controls and host handoff; encrypted recipient and SSKR recovery preserve exact entropy and passphrase.
remediation.verificationScope: Passed named targeted regressions and stated source/build checks; browser and release acceptance remain unexecuted.

remediation.title: Incomplete Orchard CSV marks provisional unspent notes as spendable
remediation.summary: Delegate Orchard note state and balance availability to ShieldedActivityState; incomplete coverage never establishes spendability.
remediation.requiredVerification: Actual serialized complete/partial FVK, IVK/OVK and known-spent cases remain consistent with summaries and other formats.
remediation.verificationScope: Passed named targeted regressions and stated source/build checks; browser and release acceptance remain unexecuted.

remediation.title: Missing-code recovery drops the captured BIP39 passphrase during Deriver handoff
remediation.summary: Carry the captured BIP39 passphrase through missing-code recovery and atomically assign both Deriver factors before dispatching input events.
remediation.requiredVerification: The bounded actual-controller request and handoff probe must pass with nonempty TREZOR and empty-passphrase controls. Verify the actual application handoff populates both parent fields, and that edits or cancellation cannot substitute another request's passphrase. Separately use an authorized public known-wallet control if claiming cryptographic wallet identity; this harness establishes argument preservation, not independent derivation correctness.
remediation.verificationScope: Passed named targeted regressions and stated source/build checks; browser and release acceptance remain unexecuted.

remediation.title: MnemoCode Decode retains usable stale results after edits and accepts old-date replies
remediation.summary: Bind codes, dates, interpretation radios and wallet factors to result ownership; reject stale replies and detached actions.
remediation.requiredVerification: All revised completed-edit and pending-date handoff probes must pass, with fresh Decode/current-date positive controls and the existing input-edit cancellation control. Assert stale Use and Copy callbacks cannot execute; do not require DOM removal if equivalent inaccessible output is retained. Verify both found-date and supplied-date outcomes, including changed dates before completion and before Use.
remediation.verificationScope: Passed named targeted regressions and stated source/build checks; browser and release acceptance remain unexecuted.

remediation.title: Platform address history is relabeled without checking its resource identity

remediation.verificationScope: Passed named targeted regressions and stated source/build checks; browser and release acceptance remain unexecuted.

remediation.title: Silent Payments publishes results for an outdated parent phrase or passphrase
remediation.summary: Invalidate Silent Payments synchronously on parent edits and generation; refuse late worker publication.
remediation.requiredVerification: The five revised actual-controller invalidation probes must pass with the fresh-source controls preserved. Cover parent mnemonic and passphrase edits, incomplete input, late replies before debounce, Generate, and later successful derivation from current fields. Hidden old text need not be erased, but it must not remain actionable or become republished by an old request. A claim about BIP352 address correctness needs separate cryptographic evidence owned by the crypto reviewer.

No real browsers, viewport/focus trees, actual browser worker/CSP lifecycle or packaged executable launchers were executed. UI tests use public fixtures with bounded fake DOM/worker replies.
No full vector/statistical replay, full-size password KDFs, mass PDF/cards, live providers, regtest, wallet funds or real secrets. Native and WASM checks are narrow known-answer/rejection samples.

No second complete reproducible release build, full feature matrix, release bundle/signature/attestation or paid GitHub Actions. The artifact target retains those gates; this run used the separate WASM target.

MnemoCode's 171 runtime files are copied unchanged from its reviewed dirty owner checkout and remain intentionally unreleased; CI release admission still requires its published handover. MHFE 0.6.0 and both Argon2 files remain unchanged.

Candidate-file ceilings bound format bytes, not whole-process heap/RSS. Maximum-size files and 524288-object allocation were not tested. JS strings, GC residue and pinned-library internal copies cannot be proven erased by these tests.
Actual Evo SDK empty-proof Map inclusion/omission semantics remain unobserved; complete explicit-null fixtures and missing-key rejection are checked.

Prior command failures and a deliberate build interruption are retained, not converted to passes. Intermediate runs may predate final formatting or unrelated changes; accepted verification uses the specified current-source checks.

The changes below came afterwards; this follow-up adds their evidence and does not relabel the completed checks. AUD-028-API006 and AUD-028-SEC005 received the corrections in items 1 to 4.

changes.summary: One rule, FieldEdits, decides which input and change events are new edits: a text field's change whose text equals its last counted edit is a repeat. Firefox delivers that change after the click that started a job, so the AUD-028-API006 ownership removed the Decode result it had just shown; a value the page replaces with change alone still counts as an edit. InputRevision uses the rule.

The concealment lifecycle listens to its own document's window, and the recovery UI self-test conceals only its fixture; before, running the full self-test also concealed every secret the person had revealed on the page.

The same rule guards six handlers that treated the repeat as an edit: the missing-code search and the Forgotten search dropped a search just started, MHFE missing words forgot a confirmed long search, the marked-container block closed after Decode showed it, and chosen words and the derivation range cancelled a checked generation or derivation just started.

Notes that fill after a typing pause keep their line (RESERVED_NOTE_LINE), and Decode shows a waiting codes fingerprint at once. Before, the fingerprint appeared 300 ms after typing above the Decode button and moved the button and a shown result down by one line under the pointer; the Forgotten size lines moved the Search button the same way.
A relative delay of one block reads "1 block".

MnemoCode refreshed from its working tree: candidate-file-refusal uses the shared whole-number rule and bits adds wipedAfterAsync, with behaviour unchanged; source.json names MnemoCode's current main. MnemoCode commit references in AUD-022, AUD-023, AUD-027 and this record name the commits of its current main; the AUD-026 document binding follows.

recovery-backup-roundtrips counts only the Recover & Back Up helps (27; the wallet-check help belongs to Generate & Derive) and waits until the MHFE panel's startup checks open it (inert fields ignored fill); a Copy failure names its panel.
The upstream checker reads pnpm from package.json and Rust and wasm-bindgen from tooling/toolchain-pins.json, which the Dockerfiles consume.
The Scanner's nineteen vendored files include the candidate-file admission and refusal modules, and @scure/base.

Expectations brought to the remediated behaviour (shared settle helper, fake document with its window and dataset, a Platform address for Platform history, the shared concurrency message, the relative-delay text) and new regressions for the edit rule, the missing-code search after a repeated change, the concealment scope and the waiting fingerprint; each new regression fails against the previous code.

observations: Earlier runs on intermediate sources failed and are retained: Chromium recovery-backup-roundtrips on the two stale test assumptions of item 7, and Firefox Dash mnemocode-roundtrip reproducibly until item 1.

Firefox Dash recovery-backup-roundtrips had failed 2 of 18 repetitions: after Show phrase in the MnemoCode panel, Copy stayed disabled. The cause was the layout shift of item 4: measured in Firefox, the result moved 26 px down about 300 ms after typing, so a click aimed at Show phrase could land above it. After the fix it passed every run.

Still open, for an owner decision on the layout: the MHFE password strength notes (Encode, Change password, New wallet, Hidden wallets) and the reference descriptions fill after a 400 ms pause above their action buttons; measured in Encode, a weak-password warning moves the Encrypt button 64 px down and back. Keeping their space while a field holds text would leave a blank gap for a strong password.
